units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 122a:7">B. Bath. 122ᵃ</cite> <he>לא כח׳ של עוה״ז וכ׳</he> the distribution of land in the future will not be like the one of the present.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 126a:9">Ib. 126ᵃ</cite> <he>יש לו לבכור קודם ח׳</he> the first-born is the legal owner of his share before the partition has taken place.
<cite ref="Ketubot 26a:6">Keth. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>בתורת ח׳</he> as an heir’s share.

<cite ref="Ketubot 94b:2">Ib. 94ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ עדיפא</he> division among two claimants (where evidence is wanted) is preferable (to discretionary adjudication to one, v. <cite ref="U00334"><he>שׁוּדָּא</he></cite>); a. e.
